name: clip-path-carousel

frames.best_why: The active slide sits at full height with its caption while neighbours stay clipped short, and the dots and arrows show.

tagline: A photo strip where the centred slide unclips to full height with its caption.
summary: A horizontal carousel of tall photographs on black. The centred slide opens to its full height and fades in a title, while the slides either side stay clipped shorter; arrows and dots move between them.
appearance: A row of portrait photographs with rounded corners on a black stage, each separated by wide gaps. The centred image is noticeably taller and carries a small grey caption beneath it, while its neighbours are cropped top and bottom; arrows and a row of dots sit below.
behaviour: Switching slides animates a clip inset so the outgoing image shrinks back to a short band and the new one opens fully, its title fading up from a blur. Arrows, dots, dragging or autoplay move it along.
demo_content: Mountain and landscape photos titled Silent Peaks, Golden Dusk, Azure Ridge and others.
search_phrases: photo carousel with active slide larger
images that unclip as you scroll
use_when: A gallery should keep a row of images in view while making the current one the clear focus.
avoid_when: It loads remote photos and clips the neighbours, so it needs generous width and a reliable image source.
customise: Props set the image list, autoplay, looping, arrows and dots; the 500px track height and the clip inset are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A row of images with one clip animation per change; no per-frame loop.

a11y.note: Arrows and dots are labelled and images have alt text, but the buttons show no focus ring and the clip animation ignores reduced-motion.

props.name: images
props.type: { src: string; alt: string; title: string }[]

issues: The neighbour slides are clipped so hard that only a sliver of each photo shows.
Captions are small, low contrast and sit outside the clipped slide.
polish_why: Crisp focus effect and a clean photo strip; tiny captions and no focus states.
title: Clip Path Carousel
